claim: The unit's excitation dichroic turret carries three slots. One dichroic is fitted, in slot 1; slots 2 and 3 are empty. The fitted dichroic stays in the path whatever the disk does, which is why this instrument has no unfiltered white-light path.
validity_conditions: This instrument as configured on 2026-09-17, operator read at the instrument. Slot 1 is as the operator identified it at the instrument; the dichroic's own spectral bands are not part of this claim and are not in the store. Falsified by fitting a second dichroic or moving the fitted one.
